TinyUSB 0.18.0
https://github.com/hathach/tinyusb
Commit: 86ad6e56c1700e85f1c5678607a762cfe3aa2f47
License: MIT (see LICENSE and source headers).
Vendored subset: common, host, HID, OS abstraction, OHCI.
PINE64 changes: portable/ohci/ohci.c uses a selected A64 controller base,
independent timeouts, explicit DMA barriers and controller deinitialization.
No NXP chip headers or NVIC calls; interrupt service is polled.
HID input callbacks report zero bytes on a failed transfer instead of
passing stale DMA buffer contents to the keyboard decoder.
